why: These kernels decide the PIXELS of a texture that has already shipped in a dataset, so a reimplementation would produce a different atlas for the same object. They are carried from the campaign that produced the shipped textures and are excluded from linting (ADR 0002).
policy: Edits are limited to import paths and to replacing build-host constants with configuration lookups. Any change that could move a pixel requires a RECIPE_VERSION bump AND moves recipe_digest, which invalidates every product on disk; the delivered-bytes digest catches a product that was not in fact regenerated.
fidelity: FUNCTIONALLY EQUIVALENT, VERIFIED -- not textually verbatim. apply_margin and dilate_full were restructured (apply_margin fills the ring before blacking out the far background rather than after; dilate_full adds an all-valid early return and gathers only over the invalid region). Equivalence was checked numerically rather than asserted: 0 mismatches over 40 randomised multi-island masks at 64/128/512 px per kernel, plus the all-valid edge case. Byte and AST equality with the originals are both false, and any claim of verbatim carriage would be wrong.
